messages:
Ava (CEO): Quick executive weekly: consolidating asks and decisions for the next two weeks. Short and actionable.

Ava (CEO): Top three priorities: 1) reduce customer-visible errors, 2) close the Private pilot readiness loop, 3) tighten cost controls on hosted growth. I want one-line owner commits in this thread by EOD from each lead.

Ava (CEO): On errors: target is user-facing errors <= 1% and p99 latency stable within 20% of yesterday's baseline across primary routes. Please treat this as a temporary SRE emergency lane until stabilized. 

Maya (VP Eng): Noted. We will pause non-critical model pushes and prioritize hotfixes. Planning an emergency deploy freeze window Tue-Wed unless it's a rollback. Will run focused tracing and heap analyses.

Diego (VP Product): For Private pilot: legal + three pilot customers ready. We need audit log defaults, support SLA stub, and a short onboarding checklist. I'll own the checklist and onboarding script.

Nora (Head of Sales): Heads-up: pilots expect GA-like support during trial. Sales will staff two TAM hours/week per customer. Please confirm readiness of support playbooks.

Sam (Head of Finance): Cost ask: Finance is modeling a 10% unit-cost improvement target across hosted for Q2. Short-term ask: prioritize batching & LRU cache for embeddings; quantify expected savings by Friday.

Liam (Head of Reliability): Short metric snapshot (yesterday -> rolling 24h): p99 235ms, user-errors 1.6%, tail-queue spikes at 3am UTC. Prefix cache hit 12%. Observations: a scaling race on small B instances, and intermittent DB throttles.

Liam (Head of Reliability): Immediate actions: 1) enable conservative reserved capacity on critical routes, 2) add 5% headroom to autoscale warm pools, 3) open PR for runbook updates. ETA: 4h.

Maya (VP Eng): We found one risky runtime commit that increases memory churn; will revert if not green in canary. Also will prioritize a memory-leak patch for the kv-cache path.

deploy-bot: Canary started: hosted-canary -> 4 nodes, build 2026.04.02-rc7. Monitoring hooks active. 

Diego (VP Product): I'll publish pilot onboarding checklist by EOD tomorrow and a trimmed support FAQ. Also creating a small "pilot feature matrix" noting which features are GA vs pilot-only.

Sam (Head of Finance): I'll deliver a simple scenario dashboard by Friday showing burn impact for 5/10/15% unit cost improvements and costs for Dedicated reservations.

Nora (Head of Sales): Commitment: Provide customer-facing pilot expectations doc and assign TAM hours by tomorrow noon.

Maya (VP Eng): Commitment: Pause risky model pushes, run memory patch in canary, and post canary results in #eng-runtime by Wed 16:00 UTC.

Liam (Head of Reliability): Commitment: Enable reserved capacity and submit runbook PR within 4 hours. I'll also schedule a 20m readiness sync with Ops.

Diego (VP Product): Commitment: Checklist + FAQ by EOD tomorrow, and coordinate with Support for the onboarding run.

Sam (Head of Finance): Commitment: Scenario deck by Friday EOD.

Ava (CEO): Thanks — appreciate the speed. Two follow-ups: 1) ops + product set a 30m go/no-go check before pilot invites, 2) PMs tag any cost changes in the forecast doc so Sam can pick up numbers. I'll drop into the go/no-go if schedule allows. :calendar:

Ava (CEO): Small request: if you read this, react with :eyes: so I can track acknowledgements.
